The agent needs to navigate the Minecraft environment to locate a polished andesite block. This task doesn't require deep Minecraft domain knowledge — the agent simply needs to visually identify and navigate to the block. It can be set up in a scene with polished andesite placed at a specific location, and completion can be verified by checking the agent's proximity to the block or by checking if the block appears in the agent's view. Since we are selecting exactly 1 task, there are no dependencies, but the task itself still requires spatial navigation and block identification skills.

scene_description: A stone garden scene with various stone-type blocks scattered around a grass field. A prominent polished andesite wall structure (3x3x3) is placed at ~6-8, ~0-2, ~8-10, about 8-10 blocks from spawn. Distractor blocks include cobblestone, regular andesite, stone, and granite scattered between spawn and the target. An oak plank shelter sits at ~-4 to ~-1, ~0-3, ~3-6 as a landmark. The player must navigate through the stone garden to locate and reach the polished andesite blocks.
task_text: Find polished andesite blocks in the scene. Navigate to the polished andesite — it has a smooth, uniform gray texture distinct from regular andesite, cobblestone, and stone.
design_notes: Polished andesite wall at ~6-8,0-2,8-10 is the target (center at ~7,1,9). Single polished_andesite at ~7,0,7 serves as a breadcrumb. Oak plank shelter at ~-4 to -1, 0-3, 3-6 serves as a landmark with a doorway. All within 10 blocks of spawn. Milestone uses max_distance=10 per team consensus (reduced from 16).
